hypothesis: Strength-matched control motivated by V65 response screen: reclosure50 and closed50 lose to V63, while closed75 slightly improves profile error. Test the same three-quarter correction on the original V63 source representation, to separate correction strength from normalization. V65 counts started; only progress/runtime logs inspected, no new count summary or accuracy used to specify this candidate.
formula: Take the exact original unguarded V62 assay_center50 array, expand its correction from V24 by 1.5 (bounded +/-0.75 and final +/-3); preserve own zero; apply exactly the original V24 80% identity-margin guard. Original source profiles and uncertainties unchanged. It is strength matched to V65 up to original float32 rounding.
selection: Before counts, select lowest equal-study target-weighted desired-profile MSE ratio versus V63 among arms with ratio<1, each study<=1.03, LFC MSE/MAE <=1.02 and equal-study mean PDS no loss>.01. Ties by ARMS order. Then lock; compare generated cells with V63, V24 and selected source-target cyclic derangement. No post-count candidate promotion. Complete all fixed unique-target cases at two seeds as diagnostics, not unseen biology. A package may be explicitly experimental on public count guard failure but must state it. No guaranteed private improvement.
validation: Canonical first case per target/context from existing V34/V37 pools: 30 unique target/context pairs, five contexts, three studies. Generation seeds 0 and620000 are technical repeats. Public biology reused; D3 unopened. Complete held-study source exclusion (HCT116 and HEK293T jointly). No query treatment in fitting.
cross_version_rule: Only V65 closed75 and this fixed V66 assay75 can be finalists. Evaluate the same canonical 30 target/context pairs and two seeds, V24/V63/shuffled controls. Prefer a candidate passing every frozen public count guard; if both pass choose lower paired equal-study generated-profile error ratio. If neither passes, any diagnostic upload must remain explicitly experimental and report all failures; prefer lower generated-profile error among mean-eligible candidates with no >3% study profile degradation and at least two raw metric gains versus V63. Do not promote additional strengths after count outcomes. No hidden-score forecast.
